issues.concern: The English translation 'Please draw a bath' is too specific and doesn't fully capture the meaning of 'お風呂を入れてください' which can also mean 'Please fill the bathtub' or 'Please prepare the bath'. 'Draw a bath' implies filling it for someone else, while the Japanese can be more general.
The English translation 'Please push with force' is a bit unnatural. A more common and natural way to express '力を入れて押してください' would be 'Please push hard' or 'Please push with all your strength'.
